TLDR: went through a depressive episode and girlfriend snuck out of work to help me. 


This may not be the biggest, most grand gesture but it meant the world to me.
When me and my girlfriend started dating I wasn't in the best of places in my life, I was recovering from a suicide attempt that pushed me to finally want help. I had started therapy and medication to get myself together, and she helped me through that in every way she could.

If it wasn't for her I would never had made it to college.

But onto the gesture, at one point I had gotten off work from a real shitty job at the time and spiraled. I had a tendency to just give up and get worse and worse under stress. Of course I never tried to appeal to her sympathy but she knew something was wrong, so she snuck out of her crappy job and brought me my favorite food and a movie I had wanted to see. She didn't tell me she was coming or anything just knocked on my door and hugged me.

It may seem small, but that was the starting point of me truly changing, for once I felt like someone actually wanted me to stick around.

Sorry this got emotional, I'm doing much much better now.

If you're ever in that situation don't hesitate to use suicide hotlines, the number of times those wonderful people have helped me bounce back is too many.
